items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Emmanuel didn't tell you how he, he used to go to the fire and tell them in the jobs... He followed Emmanuel to the ferryman... I sure would like to see Emmanuel.

ctx.x: And made a round of all the places where he used to go downtown, you know. And then he came back home. Was the last time.

Well, Emmanuel didn't tell you how he, he used to go to the fire and tell them in the jobs. He had beautiful eyes. He got all over the jobs. And he followed Emmanuel to the ferryman. You never told him about that, did he? He didn't tell you all about that? No. I can tell everybody. He wasn't very old when he died at all. He was 46, is that right? No. No. No. No, he was 30. 36. 36. 36. That's the age of 36. 36. That's a million. Billion. Billion. Billion.

36, you know. Because you lived there quite a while ago. I always think of him like an old man. Yeah. Yeah. An old man. Because he's the old man. Yes. Because they would be the same age. Yes. Mama 76. Yeah, I'm 76 since July. He was a real young man when he died. Yeah. And that famous already when he's only 36. Yeah. Yeah. How long did he stay with the circus, did you say?
